meta: Sleep better with AI: you plan to sleep early but scroll your phone until late, so ask AI for an evening routine that's easy to keep.

muc.title: Scrolling until late
muc.text: Planning to sleep early and then scrolling until midnight is common. AI can help you build an evening routine you can keep.

muc.title: An evening schedule
muc.text: Tell AI when you need to wake up and ask for an evening schedule: screens off, dim the lights, read a book.

muc.title: Track seven days
muc.text: Each morning write down when you slept, how often you woke up and how you feel. After seven days, ask AI what helps you sleep.

muc.title: When to see a doctor
muc.text: If you can't sleep for weeks, snore loudly or stop breathing in your sleep, see a doctor. Don't buy sleeping pills on your own.

muc.title: Start tonight
muc.text: Ask AI for a 30-minute bedtime routine plus a seven-day log, and start tonight.
